CSV to User Defined Struct and DataTable

ForgeMCP exposes unreal_preview_csv_import and unreal_apply_csv_import for a connected Unreal Editor session. The preview reads a CSV through the native Editor bridge, reports inferred field types and row count, and creates a single-use, five-minute plan. Apply requires the same preview_id as confirmation.

The native adapter accepts .csv files within the active Unreal project, up to 128 MiB, 200,000 data rows, and 256 columns. Headers must be unique Unreal identifiers. The selected row-key column must be nonempty and unique. CSV contents are fingerprinted at preview and rechecked at apply. Data Table creation uses Unreal's CSV importer and fails if it reports import problems or the resulting row count differs from the preview.

The operation creates a new DataTable. The User Defined Struct can either be created at a new path or updated at an existing /Game/ path. For an existing struct, preview marks each CSV field as preserve, add, or row_key, and records the exact struct schema. Apply refuses to proceed if that schema has changed since preview. Existing members are preserved; missing CSV fields are added. A same-named member with a different or unsupported type is a blocking conflict. Existing member types are never changed, and additional existing members are retained. The row-key column becomes DataTable row names and is not added as a member. Other CSV columns retain their header names as variable display names. Type overrides can select string, name, bool, int, int64, or double. Without overrides, the preview scans every value: boolean text maps to Boolean, integral values to Integer or Integer64 based on range, other numeric values to Double, and mixed or empty columns to String. Inferred values are suggestions; callers should review astronomical measurements and identifier fields before applying. The row-key column is not a struct field, so type overrides for that column are rejected.

The destination DataTable must be new. Before changing an existing struct, the adapter snapshots its member definitions and saved package bytes. It compiles and validates the updated struct before importing the CSV; if import or save fails, it attempts to restore the original in-memory schema and package. A rollback failure is reported as rollback_failed and requires inspection in the Editor before further work. Successful schema additions can affect assets that use the struct, so preview results must be reviewed before apply.

Example preview request:

{
  "session_id": "unreal-12345",
  "request": {
    "csv_path": "[local path]",
    "struct_path": "/Game/Space/Blueprints/ST_CelestialBodyData",
    "data_table_path": "/Game/Data/DT_CelestialBodies",
    "row_key_column": "id",
    "type_overrides": {
      "distance": "double",
      "catalog_id": "string"
    }
  }
}

The apply result reports both asset paths, total struct field count, added field names, DataTable row count, and whether an existing struct was updated. The adapter never evaluates CSV content as code.
